title: overlay: add a Volatile option, used for the context overlay
body:
#### What type of PR is this?

/kind bug

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

buildah 1.44 added a build-context overlay, which isn't volatile, so unmounting it after the build syncs the whole filesystem under its upper directory. This caused a 5-24s (once 70s) delay after tagging on shared CI nodes. This PR adds a Volatile option in pkg/overlay, used for the context overlay, and falls back to a plain mount if the kernel rejects it.

#### How to verify it

Run the new unit test `TestMountWithOptionsVolatile` as root (it skips otherwise), and run a build: the context overlay shows `volatile` (or `fsync=volatile`) in `/proc/self/mountinfo`, and there's no wait after the image is committed.

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:

Related to #6892.

#### Special notes for your reviewer:

None

#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?

Builds no longer wait on a filesystem sync at the end.
